description: Source code for handling symbols and properties in a configuration system, including symbol definitions, value calculations, dependency checks, and search functionalities.

methods.name: sym_get_type
methods.description: Returns the type of a symbol, converting tristate to boolean if necessary.

methods.name: sym_type_name
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a symbol's type.

methods.name: sym_get_choice_prop
methods.description: Retrieves the choice property associated with a symbol.

methods.name: sym_get_default_prop
methods.description: Retrieves the default property of a symbol.

methods.name: sym_get_range_prop
methods.description: Retrieves the range property of a symbol.

methods.name: sym_get_range_val
methods.description: Gets the numerical value of a symbol based on its type and base.

methods.name: sym_validate_range
methods.description: Validates and adjusts a symbol's value within its defined range.

methods.name: sym_set_changed
methods.description: Marks a symbol as changed and updates related menu flags.

methods.name: sym_set_all_changed
methods.description: Marks all symbols as changed.

methods.name: sym_calc_visibility
methods.description: Calculates the visibility of a symbol based on its properties and dependencies.

methods.name: sym_choice_default
methods.description: Finds the default symbol for a choice.

methods.name: sym_calc_choice
methods.description: Calculates the default choice symbol for a given symbol.

methods.name: sym_calc_value
methods.description: Calculates the current value of a symbol based on dependencies and defaults.

methods.name: sym_clear_all_valid
methods.description: Clears the validity flags for all symbols and recalculates the main symbol.

methods.name: sym_tristate_within_range
methods.description: Checks if a tristate value is within the allowed range for a symbol.

methods.name: sym_set_tristate_value
methods.description: Sets a symbol's tristate value, respecting range constraints.

methods.name: sym_toggle_tristate_value
methods.description: Cycles a symbol's tristate value through its possible states.

methods.name: sym_string_valid
methods.description: Validates if a string value is valid for a symbol.

methods.name: sym_string_within_range
methods.description: Checks if a string value is within the symbol's defined range.

methods.name: sym_set_string_value
methods.description: Sets a string value for a symbol, validating and updating flags.

methods.name: sym_get_string_default
methods.description: Retrieves the default string value for a symbol.

methods.name: sym_get_string_value
methods.description: Retrieves the current string value of a symbol.

methods.name: sym_is_changeable
methods.description: Determines if a symbol's value can be changed.

methods.name: sym_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a symbol by name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: sym_find
methods.description: Finds a symbol by name, excluding constants.

methods.name: sym_check_deps
methods.description: Checks for recursive or cyclic dependencies among symbols.
